summary: NFC tag discovery callback directly invokes model.nfc.onTag without exception handling; a malformed/unsupported tag could crash the app.
claim: App crash on invalid NFC tag instead of graceful rejection, violating strict malformed/duplicate/version validation and robustness.

evidence.source: MainActivity.onTagDiscovered(tag) = model.nfc.onTag(tag) with no try/catch; core validation may throw on malformed input.

suggested_remediation: Wrap onTag in try/catch, route exceptions to UI error state (e.g., model.nfcError) and display a notice.
suggested_validation: Instrumented test with malformed tag fires callback; app shows error and does not crash.
